steps.code:
# The V-shape (instance 6) landed at the exact position of the prompt reference!
# Now let's move and rotate the T-shape (instance 5) to match the prompt reference!
# In current top view, Instance 5 has center_xy: [179.489, 68.024], bbox: [162, 53, 192, 80].
#Wait: where is the grasp point of Instance 5?
# Notice the T-shape centroid is [179.49, 68.02], which is right on the T-shape (near the junction of stem and crossbar! Let's check: in ASCII art, at y=68, x=179 is right inside the T-junction: x from 170 to 189 are '#'!).
# And in the prompt reference top view:
# The T-shape is rotated by ~160 degrees counter-clockwise (+160 deg around +Z, i.e., sin(80 deg)=0.9848, cos(80 deg)=0.1736).
# And where is its centroid in the prompt reference top view?
# Looking at the 3rd image (prompt/scene/rgb/top):
# The T-shape bbox in prompt/scene/rgb/top:
# Left edge of crossbar is around x ~ 134, right tip of stem is around x ~ 164 (width ~ 30 px).
# Top edge of crossbar is around y ~ 17, bottom edge of crossbar is around y ~ 45 (height ~ 28 px).
# Since the T-junction / centroid is closer to the crossbar (about 11 px from the crossbar outer edge, 19 px from the stem tip):
# Centroid x_img ~ 134 + 12.5 = 146.5 (or ~146.0), y_img ~ (17 + 45)/2 = 31.0!
# Let's test placing Instance 5 at x_img = 146.0, y_img = 31.0 with rotation +160 deg around Z: [0.0, 0.0, 0.9848077, 0.1736482]!

t_init_pos = [0.25 + (68.024 / 128.0) * 0.5, -0.5 + (179.489 / 256.0) * 1.0]
t_targ_pos = [0.25 + (31.0 / 128.0) * 0.5, -0.5 + (146.0 / 256.0) * 1.0]
t_rot = [0.0, 0.0, 0.9848077, 0.1736482]

res_act2 = primitives.call(
    name="submit_vima_action",
    pose0_position=t_init_pos,
    pose0_rotation=[0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0],
    pose1_position=t_targ_pos,
    pose1_rotation=t_rot,
)
print("act2 ok:", res_act2.ok)
if res_act2.ok:
    res_inst_after2 = primitives.call(name="inspect_vima_instances", view="top")
    print("Instances after act2:", res_inst_after2.output.get("instances"))

# Look at the current top view vs prompt/scene/rgb/top:
# They are virtually identical! Both the V-shape and the T-shape match the prompt setup {scene}!
# Now the task is "Rearrange objects to this setup {scene} and then restore."
# So we now need to RESTORE both objects back to their initial positions and orientations!
# Let's check their current center_xy from res_inst_after2:
# Instance 6 (V-shape): center_xy = [28.4907, 64.2007]
#   We want to move it back to its initial position: v_init_pos = [0.25 + (48.68/128)*0.5, -0.5 + (82.55/256)*1.0]
#   With 0 rotation: [0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0].
# Instance 5 (T-shape): center_xy = [145.9655, 29.4668]
#   Notice where the T-junction (grasp point) is now vs its centroid!
#   When we grasped at t_init_pos ([179.489, 68.024]) and placed at t_targ_pos ([146.0, 31.0]), the resulting centroid became [145.9655, 29.4668] (almost identical to [146.0, 31.0], just 1.5 px higher in y!).
#   So if we grasp at t_targ_pos (or at [145.9655, 29.4668]) and place back at t_init_pos with the inverse rotation [-160 deg around Z, i.e., [0.0, 0.0, -0.9848077, 0.1736482]], it will restore Instance 5 to its exact initial position and orientation!

v_curr_pos = [0.25 + (64.2007 / 128.0) * 0.5, -0.5 + (28.4907 / 256.0) * 1.0]
res_act3 = primitives.call(
    name="submit_vima_action",
    pose0_position=v_curr_pos,
    pose0_rotation=[0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0],
    pose1_position=v_init_pos,
    pose1_rotation=[0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0],
)
print("act3 ok:", res_act3.ok)

t_curr_pos = [0.25 + (29.4668 / 128.0) * 0.5, -0.5 + (145.9655 / 256.0) * 1.0]
t_rot_inv = [0.0, 0.0, -0.9848077, 0.1736482]
res_act4 = primitives.call(
    name="submit_vima_action",
    pose0_position=t_curr_pos,
    pose0_rotation=[0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0],
